name: Meddling
overview: Scripture warns against meddling through the destructive behavior of talebearers and those who sow strife among others. The Lord commands His people not to be talebearers or stand idly by in harm's way, emphasizing the wisdom of restraining one's words rather than spreading secrets or discord. Meddling is associated with foolishness and leads to broken relationships, as those who reveal secrets or whisper cause division among friends. Believers are called to pursue peace and honor by refraining from involvement in harmful gossip and strife.
